caveats.en: Built for x86 only and its drivers are x64-only, which Prism cannot emulate. A June 2026 install attempt on Snapdragon ended during driver installation. Use Hyper-V or VirtualBox 7.2 (Arm host, experimental) instead.
caveats.zh-TW: 只為 x86 開發，驅動程式也只有 x64 版，Prism 無法模擬。2026 年 6 月有人在 Snapdragon 上安裝，到驅動程式階段就失敗。可改用 Hyper-V 或 VirtualBox 7.2（Arm 主機，實驗性質）。

evidence.title: Broadcom community: Workstation not supported on Snapdragon; install fails (Jun 2026)
